robust.label: Finite-scenario planner
robust.definition: Exact locked priority queues, worst spill, minimum-relative tie bands, grid mean, crew time, illustrative cost and stable ID.

no_work.label: No additional discretionary work
no_work.definition: Retain the verified starting state and return from the current location using the same deadline.

downstream_first.label: Downstream-first heuristic
downstream_first.definition: Reviewed topology rank then shorter nominal job then stable ID; skip jobs that cannot fit their upper bound, reconsider prerequisites, and use observed elapsed time. Defined heuristic, not independently validated expert practice.

marginal_benefit.label: Marginal hydraulic benefit per crew minute
marginal_benefit.definition: Recompute frozen planning-grid mean marginal spill reduction after each observed completion, divided by incremental nominal work and travel time. Apply protected-location screening and the common upper-bound gate; stop if no positive supported increment exists.

deterministic_nominal.label: Deterministic nominal planner
deterministic_nominal.definition: Exact planning using hydraulic scenario P1 and nominal job durations; the same declared upper-bound dispatch gate still applies.

user_entered.label: User-entered comparison
user_entered.definition: The queue entered independently by the user, replayed under the same constraints; no operator expertise is claimed.

planning_scenarios.title: Balanced design event
planning_scenarios.description: Synthetic symmetric 50-minute triangular inflows; low tailwater; nominal work durations.

planning_scenarios.title: Branch A dominant event
planning_scenarios.description: Synthetic A-dominant triangular inflows; upper-bound durations.

planning_scenarios.title: Branch B dominant event
planning_scenarios.description: Synthetic B-dominant triangular inflows; shorter observed work durations.

planning_scenarios.title: Elevated receiving water
planning_scenarios.description: Elevated fixed tailwater with otherwise balanced inflow. Backflow is allowed.

decision_manifest.screened_states: Every completed prefix plus final state, under the matching planning forcing
decision_manifest.duration_information: Realised durations are read only after dispatch; planning ensemble used to select locked policies
decision_manifest.grid_mean_interpretation: Unweighted mean of declared scenarios; not an expected annual loss

limitations: Synthetic finite-scenario dry-maintenance reference; no field benefit established.
Protected-location non-worsening does not imply flood-free or safe conditions.
Dispatch comparison assumes uniform travel and verified binary restoration.
Downstream-first is an explicit topology heuristic, not validated operator practice.
